subject: Ascend productization & OEM POC kickoff
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@ascend.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@ascend.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: OEM POC idea — Ascend x Redwood

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the convo at the AI Summit — really appreciated the demo. We talked internally at Ascend and there's strong interest in a small OEM/white-label POC: we want to embed Redwood's inference runtime into our Insights product so we can ship a branded assistant that uses our data connectors.

High-level asks from our side:
- Lightweight rebrand (logo removal + colors)
- Deployable bundle we can run in our VPC (short-term: a hosted fall-back)
- Controls for telemetry and opt-out for customers
- A mutual action plan with milestones for a 6-week POC

I've attached a quick scope doc for the MVP. Can your team run through feasibility? If this is promising, we'd like to kick off a technical + commercial sync next week.

Thanks — Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, Ascend Analytics
attachments: Ascend_MVP_scope_v1.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@ascend.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: OEM POC idea — Ascend x Redwood

Hi Liam — great to hear from you and glad the Summit sparked ideas. Karthik (partnerships) and Vanessa (solutions) are copied — we'll own the POC from product and GTM.

Quick feasibility notes before a deeper technical sync:
- Rebrand: supported — we have a \"white-label\" mode that removes Redwood branding and allows partner CSS wrappers; we typically require a lightweight co-marketing clause in the agreement.
- Deployable bundle: we offer a Private deployment package that can run in a customer VPC; for a 6-week POC we can provide a short-term hosted sandbox backed by the same runtime for speed.
- Telemetry: we can toggle telemetry and redact PII; fully opt-outtable telemetry requires a packaged build and an NDA for source-level controls.
- SLA/support: for POC we'll commit to prioritized Slack + weekly check-ins; any production Dedicated arrangement would follow the dedicated capacity terms.

If you agree, let's do a 60-minute kickoff on Thurs Aug 27. Karthik — can your team scope the engineering requirements? Vanessa — can you prep a short MxP (mutual action plan) we can share with Ascend?

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: OEM POC idea — Ascend x Redwood

Sofia / Vanessa — quick internal notes after reading the scope doc:
- Runtime packaging: we can produce a containerized bundle (~20GB compressed with quantized model) that runs inference in Ascend's VPC. We'll need kernel compatibility matrix from Ascend (GPU type / driver / k8s distro).
- Licensing options: 90-day POC license + evaluation SLA; commercial terms can be the standard OEM term sheet (I attached a draft earlier).
- Security: will require KMS integration for customer keys and an audit log endpoint; data retention default is 30d for logs but we can adjust per contract.
- Telemetry/telemetry opt-out: there are three levels — full telemetry, scrubbed telemetry, no telemetry. No telemetry increases debugging time for us.

Action items:
1) Vanessa: draft the MxP with milestones and owners (engineering, security review, legal).
2) Sofia: coordinate kickoff with Ascend for Aug 27.
3) I'll pull the OEM term sheet and propose a minimal set of redlines for POC.

Karthik
Senior Partner Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Priya Desai <priya@ascend.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: OEM POC idea — Ascend x Redwood

Thanks all — Thurs Aug 27 at 10am PT works. Agenda request from our side (30m technical + 30m commercial):
- Tech: runtime packaging options (container vs. VM image), minimal GPU requirements, network egress patterns, telemetry endpoints, and SSO for admin console.
- Commercial: POC license term, logo/rebrand terms, support expectations, and basic pricing for first 12 months if we go to production.

Also: adding Ethan Miller (lead infra) to the thread — Ethan can share the infra matrix (we're on GKE with A100s).

Attachments: asc_infra_matrix.xlsx (sent separately)

Looking forward,
Priya
Head of Product — Ascend Analytics
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@ascend.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@ascend.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: OEM POC idea — Ascend x Redwood

Thanks for the kickoff today — good session. Recap + next steps (owners and dates):

1) Engineering spike (compatibility + container build) — owner: Karthik / Redwood Eng — deliverable: trial container + runbook by Fri Sep 10.
2) MxP (milestones + success criteria) — owner: Vanessa — deliverable: shared MxP doc (Drive link) by Tue Sep 7.
3) Security checklist (KMS, audit logs, data retention options) — owner: Ascend (Ethan) + Redwood security — initial answers by Wed Sep 8.
4) Term sheet for POC (90 days) — owner: Karthik / Ascend legal — draft shared by Mon Aug 31 (attached redlines).

Two quick clarifications from our side:
- For the POC bundle we will provide a \"rebrand token\" that removes Redwood logos and allows partner CSS wrappers; full white-labeling (source code removal / OEM redistribution) will need an OEM license and a slightly longer commercial lead time.
- Telemetry: to keep debugging time reasonable we recommend scrubbed telemetry for the POC; we can ship a no-telemetry build if Ascend accepts an extended troubleshooting SLA.

Attachments included: redwood-oem-term-sheet-20260831.pdf

If everyone confirms the owners/dates above, we'll lock the MxP and start the spike.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
